title: Client
purpose: Create a client organization or update its account details, contact, mailing address, invoicing details, report instructions and notes. Editing also controls whether the client can receive new intake.

sections.title: Layout and access
paragraphs: Project managers and administrators can save. The form is grouped into sections: Account, Primary contact, Mailing address, Invoicing, Reports and notes, and, on edit only, Status and Change record. Only Name is required when creating a client; every other field is optional unless noted.
These details are records for the laboratory's use. Nothing here sends reports or invoices, creates a portal login or changes who can see the client's projects.

items.label: Name
items.description: Required organization name, up to 160 characters, as it should appear on reports.

items.label: Account code
items.description: Optional short code the laboratory uses for this client, up to 40 characters. When given it must be unique: saving a code another client already uses is refused with a message on the form. Several clients may leave it blank.

items.label: Contact name
items.description: Optional primary contact, up to 160 characters; the person reports are addressed to. Use additional contact records for other people.

items.label: Email
items.description: Optional primary email; must be a valid email address if supplied.

items.label: Phone
items.description: Optional primary phone, up to 40 characters. Free text; no format is enforced.

items.label: Street address
items.description: Optional, up to 160 characters.

items.label: Suite, building or PO box
items.description: Optional second address line, up to 160 characters.

items.label: City
items.description: Optional, up to 80 characters.

items.label: State
items.description: Optional list: Select… (blank), then a list of the 50 states, the District of Columbia and the territories (American Samoa, Guam, Northern Mariana Islands, Puerto Rico, U.S. Virgin Islands), shown by name.

items.label: ZIP code
items.description: Optional, up to 12 characters. Free text; the format is not checked.

sections.title: Invoicing
paragraphs: Leave the invoicing fields blank when the primary contact also receives invoices. The client record then shows Primary contact and Same as mailing address.

items.label: Invoice-to contact
items.description: Optional name, up to 160 characters, of who receives invoices.

items.label: Invoice email
items.description: Optional valid email address for invoices.

items.label: Billing address
items.description: Optional multi-line address. Blank means invoices go to the mailing address.

items.label: Payment terms
items.description: Optional list: Not set, Due on receipt, Net 15 days, Net 30 days, Net 45 days, Net 60 days or Prepaid. Recorded for reference; it does not create invoices or due dates.

items.label: Purchase order required
items.description: Checkbox, initially unchecked. Information for intake: when checked, a chain of custody for this client that has no purchase order shows a Purchase order missing warning. It does not block receipt.

items.label: Report instructions
items.description: Optional multi-line text on how this client wants reports: recipients, format, electronic deliverable. Information only; nothing is sent automatically.

items.label: Internal notes
items.description: Optional multi-line notes for laboratory staff. Not shown to the client.

sections.title: Status and change record
paragraphs: These sections appear on edit only.

items.label: Active (accepts new intake)
items.description: Creation starts the client active. Clear it to block new projects and new intake for this client while retaining existing work and history.

items.label: Reason for change
items.description: Required on edit. Explains the change and is retained with the actor and the old and new values.

sections.title: Actions and safeguards
paragraphs: A concurrent edit is refused. Review the error, reload the current record and compare before resubmitting; validation errors are shown with the submitted form. Client editing does not change its project ownership or create a portal login.

items.label: Create client
items.description: Project managers and administrators create the client and open its record.

items.label: Save changes
items.description: Edit action records the attributed change and returns to the client record.

items.label: Cancel
items.description: Creation returns to Clients; editing returns to this client’s record without saving.
